ContextIQ Sample Text Fixture

This plain-text fixture exists to exercise the ingestion pipeline's
text-file path end to end: extraction treats a .txt upload as a single
page, chunking splits it into several overlapping windows, and each
chunk is embedded and persisted alongside a generated full-text search
vector.

The Week 1 sign-off test searches this document for the word wombat,
a deliberately rare token chosen so a to_tsquery match against
content_tsv can only succeed if the generated column is genuinely
populated and queryable, not merely non-null.

Repeated filler text follows so the document is long enough to span
multiple chunks under the default chunk_size of five hundred
characters with a fifty character overlap, which lets the sign-off
test also verify that chunk_index stays contiguous from zero and that
every chunk's page_number falls within the document's real page
range, here just page one, since plain text has no page boundaries.
